content_sections.heading: About the Corporation
content_sections.text: NERAMAC is a Government of India Enterprise under the administrative control of the Ministry of Development of North Eastern Region (DoNER). Its notice says the corporation promotes agri-horti products of the North Eastern Region, sourced directly from entrepreneurs, FPOs, SHGs and local producers. The office is at NERAMAC Complex, Sixmile, Guwahati, Assam.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Full-time Graduate from a recognized University/Institute. Preference will be given to candidates possessing an MBA/PGDM in Marketing. All qualifications must be from a UGC recognized University, UGC recognized deemed University, AICTE approved autonomous institution, or an equivalent degree recognized by the Govt. of India (wherever applicable). Minimum of 2 years of work experience. Preference will be given to candidates with prior experience in retail marketing and business development. Proficiency in MS Office, MS Excel, etc., and excellent communication, negotiation and presentation skills are listed with the experience requirement. Willingness to travel for retail outlet visits, promotional events and meetings. Candidates with maximum experience of a Public Sector Undertaking or large organization of repute would be preferred. The age limit is not exceeding 32 years as on 1 December 2026. Relaxation may be granted at the discretion of the Competent Authority; the notice prints no category-wise relaxation. The applicant must be a citizen of India. Candidates should check the official notification for the full eligibility conditions of the post.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: Total emoluments are up to Rs.30,000/- per month. The engagement is on a contractual basis: after a probation period of 3 months, it is initially for two (02) years, and it can be extended or renewed depending on the Corporation's requirement and the performance of the person engaged. The engaged person draws a consolidated monthly remuneration only. No other allowance or remuneration is payable for working on holidays or outside office hours. Leaves are as per the Corporation rules for contract employees. The selected candidate would be eligible for increment as per policy promulgated from time to time. The engaged person is liable to be transferred to any other location or branch when required.

content_sections.heading: NERAMAC Sr. Executive – (Marketing – Retail) Job Description
content_sections.text: The notice says the Sr. Executive will drive retail business growth by expanding market presence, enhancing customer engagement and implementing marketing strategies that boost sales and brand visibility. Products are sourced directly from entrepreneurs, FPOs, SHGs and local producers rather than external traders. The listed duties are: Retail Market Development: identify and establish new retail outlets, franchise opportunities and distribution channels. Sales & Revenue Growth: achieve sales targets through marketing campaigns, upselling and cross-selling. Customer Relationship Management: build and maintain strong relationships with retail partners, distributors and customers. Marketing Strategy Execution: plan and implement promotional campaigns, merchandising activities and brand-building initiatives. Market Research & Competitor Analysis: monitor competitor activities, pricing strategies and consumer trends. Operational Coordination: collaborate with supply chain, logistics and marketing teams. Reporting & Documentation: prepare periodic sales reports, marketing performance reviews and business development documentation. Retail Staff Training: guide and train retail staff on product knowledge, sales techniques and customer engagement. Strategic Partnerships: explore collaborations with retail chains, e-commerce platforms and vendors. Travel Flexibility: be available for travel to retail outlets, promotional events and partner meetings. Entrepreneur Product Sourcing: ensure retail outlets stock products developed or supplied by registered entrepreneurs, FPOs, SHGs and cooperatives. Market Linkages: facilitate direct connections between entrepreneurs and retail outlets, eliminating middlemen. Quality Assurance: monitor and maintain product standards to build consumer trust in entrepreneur-driven goods. Brand Promotion: highlight "Made by Local Entrepreneurs" branding in retail marketing campaigns. Sales Growth: position entrepreneur products as authentic, organic and regionally unique. Documentation & Reporting: maintain records of entrepreneur participation, product categories and sales performance.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for NERAMAC Sr. Executive – (Marketing – Retail)
content_sections.text: Prepare the application form along with relevant testimonials. Send it by email to [email protected] , or by post to the address below, on or before 25 November 2026. Postal address: NERAMAC Complex, Panjabari Road, (Near Six-mile Flyover), Sixmile, Guwahati, Pin – 781019, Assam. The notice does not print an application form format or an email subject line. For any clarification, the notice names AM-HR, NERAMAC at 7002266904. Application form with relevant testimonials, sent by email or post. Full Bio-data, to be brought if called for interview. Necessary educational and experience certificates in original, to be brought at the interview. No Objection Certificate from the present employer, at the time of interview, for persons working under Central/State Govt., a Public Sector Undertaking or an Autonomous body.

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: The management will call candidates for an interview only on the basis of their declaration in the application form. The interview date will be informed to shortlisted candidates only, and they will appear at the NERAMAC Complex address above. Mere fulfilment of eligibility criteria does not entitle a candidate to be called for test or interview. The management reserves the right to raise the standard of qualification, percentage of marks or experience above the minimum prescribed, to restrict the number of candidates called. Candidates should bring their original testimonials on the date of the interview.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are there in NERAMAC Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There is one (01) vacancy, for the post of Sr. Executive – (Marketing – Retail), on a contractual basis.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply?
faq.answer: Application forms with testimonials must be submitted by email or post on or before 25.11.2026.

faq.question: Q3. What is the qualification for NERAMAC Sr. Executive – (Marketing – Retail)?
faq.answer: A full-time graduate from a recognized University/Institute with a minimum of 2 years of work experience. Preference goes to candidates with an MBA/PGDM in Marketing.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit?
faq.answer: The age should not exceed 32 years as on 1 December 2026. Relaxation may be granted at the discretion of the Competent Authority.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary?
faq.answer: Total emoluments are up to Rs.30,000/- per month, paid as a consolidated monthly remuneration.

faq.question: Q6. How can I apply?
faq.answer: Send the application form with relevant testimonials to [email protected], or by post to NERAMAC Complex, Panjabari Road, (Near Six-mile Flyover), Sixmile, Guwahati, Pin – 781019, Assam, by 25.11.2026.

faq.question: Q7. How are candidates selected?
faq.answer: Candidates are called for interview on the basis of their declaration in the application form. Only shortlisted candidates are informed of the interview date.

faq.question: Q8. Is this a permanent job?
faq.answer: No. It is a contractual engagement, initially for two (02) years after a 3-month probation period, and it can be extended or renewed. The engaged person cannot claim absorption or regularization.

faq.question: Q9. Will TA/DA be paid for the interview?
faq.answer: No. The notice states that no TA/DA will be paid to any candidate for appearing in the interview.

faq.question: Q10. Is a No Objection Certificate needed?
faq.answer: Persons working under Central/State Govt., a Public Sector Undertaking or an Autonomous body must submit a No Objection Certificate from their present employer at the time of interview.
